annotations.title: Axion Doors registry — source, method and check date per door

description: The Axion Doors registry: every machine-callable door this estate operates, each with the trust block an agent should read before believing a tool result — the named source the data comes from, the validation method actually applied to it, the date the source was last checked, and an honesty grade saying where the measurement is weak. Also lists the free endpoints, the MCP servers, and the priced doors that are dormant (they answer HTTP 402 with an empty accepts[] until a payment rail is live). Filter by zone, or ask for one field across every zone.

trust_only.description: Return only the trust blocks — source, validation method, check date, honesty grade — without the endpoint lists.

zone.description: Zone hostname or a fragment of it — e.g. 'appealsdesk', 'nyc', 'mtd'. Omit for every zone.
